title: Boucharo - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Boucharo in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Boucharo is a fire-element weapon used by Monoco. It scales with Agility (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Boucharo Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (B), Luck (C). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
